Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: independent full-screen 16:9 game background, 1920x1080 or 2048x1152 landscape, for a Chinese campus daily life card strategy game. This is a real background asset, not a mockup or sprite sheet.
Primary request: Create a polished early morning version of the cozy student dormitory in the reference, preserving its hand-painted ink-and-watercolor picture-book style and relatable modest student life. Shift from nighttime amber to soft fresh daylight and quiet optimism.
Input image 1: style and room reference only. Keep the same visual family: warm paper grain, fine brown ink lines, gentle watercolor shading, restrained detail.
Scene: contemporary Chinese university dorm study corner. A bright window and pale sage curtain at the far left, distant simple campus buildings and gingko trees outside. At bottom left and bottom right a wood study desk with a closed workbook, pen cup, plain enamel mug and a small breakfast bowl. Small potted plant and shelf at the upper-right edge. No person.
Composition: Full-bleed wide illustration, no border. Keep the central 55 percent of the image, especially x=30%-80%, y=15%-70%, as a spacious pale cream wall with very little detail and no strong lines; game cards will overlay it. Important props cluster at edges and bottom 20%. Window must feel morning, no moon. Do not copy pictograms or phone text from the reference.
Lighting/mood: softly sunlit, lived-in, calm and welcoming. Palette cream parchment, muted sage, light honey wood and small terracotta accents, no heavy yellow filter or dark vignette.
Constraints: No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no logos, no watermarks, no montage, no frames, no detached decorative sheets. Preserve full subject outlines and all four edges.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: separate full-screen 16:9 landscape background for a Chinese university daily-life strategy card game. Generate ONE full-bleed image, 1920x1080 or 2048x1152 if available.
Primary request: a relaxing contemporary Chinese university courtyard in the early afternoon, in the SAME warm ink-and-watercolor picture-book style as the attached dorm image. This background goes behind selectable action cards.
Input image 1: art-style reference only, not the requested room or composition. Match delicate brown ink outlines, soft paper grain, controlled watercolor washes, cozy lived-in charm.
Scene: quiet pedestrian lane between simple low-rise university buildings, gingko trees and plane trees along both sides. At the far-left edge a shaded campus bench with a closed book on it and a low brick planter; at the right edge a few everyday city bicycles parked by a small green hedge. Modest Chinese campus architecture, cream stucco, brick, simple square windows, no Gothic, no castle, no arches. No prominent people.
Composition: wide 16:9, no panels or border. Low-detail pale cream sunlit pavement and faint greenery across the central 55% of the frame for game cards; tree canopies frame upper corners and objects sit at outer edges. Keep middle area open with low contrast; the horizon and buildings are high near the top fifth. Carefully drawn natural cast shadows near the edges.
Lighting/mood: soft green afternoon daylight, calm breathing space between classes. Color palette muted sage and gingko greens, warm ivory, honey brown, tiny terracotta accents. No photographic rendering, no saturated vivid landscape, no dark vignette.
Constraints: NO text, NO signs with letters, no logos, no numbers, no UI elements, no decorative frames, no montage, no grid, no watermark. Clean intact edges.

Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: separate 16:9 full-bleed game background for the evening action scene of a Chinese university life strategy game.
Primary request: transform the reference university courtyard from sunny afternoon to peaceful blue-hour evening. Preserve the exact scene, camera, Chinese university architecture, tree positions, benches and bicycles, as well as warm paper grain, delicate brown ink outlines and gentle watercolor style. No additions of characters.
Lighting/mood: the sun has just set; quiet muted periwinkle sky and soft desaturated blue-sage foliage. A few small windows and the existing lamppost emit restrained amber light. Warm cream paving still readable in the middle for overlaid game cards. Cozy, reflective, safe and calm, never spooky. Autumn gingko leaves are restrained gold against the cool evening.
Composition: keep the center 55% open, low detail and low contrast; retain intact full-bleed edges, wide 16:9 landscape. No extra framing or borders.
Constraints: change only time-of-day and lighting. No text, no signs with writing, no UI, no visible moon needing a composition change, no montage, no grid, no watermarks, no logos. Do not make it photorealistic, bright violet or heavily saturated. Match the game's hand-painted storybook family.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one independent landscape 16:9 full-screen background for the destination selection screen of a Chinese university daily-life card game. 1920x1080 or 2048x1152 landscape. A real illustrated map asset, never a UI mockup or contact sheet.
Primary request: a warm, beautiful, hand-painted isometric campus map that feels like a small tabletop game world. Match the attached reference's fine brown ink, watercolor paint, muted autumn greens, gingko gold and warm parchment. The game overlays clickable illustrated destination props and cards, so do NOT bake any UI or names into this image.
Scene: modest contemporary Chinese university, viewed from gently tilted overhead. Connected warm cream walkways wind between leafy courtyards and small campus buildings. Three principal destinations: a small canteen building toward the upper-middle-left, a compact campus convenience shop toward upper-middle-right, and a student dormitory toward lower-right. A tiny campus gate/delivery pickup shelter near middle-right connects by a footpath. Benches, gingko trees and parked bicycles at edges make it lived-in. No castles, no Gothic buildings, no prominent people.
Composition: full-bleed wide map. The leftmost 22% and bottom-left corner should mostly be softly painted trees and paths, because the existing character portrait and status card occupy that area. Keep four overlay areas quiet and low-contrast at approximate normalized centers (0.40,0.35), (0.70,0.35), (0.47,0.65), (0.78,0.67). Buildings sit nearby, not directly under those low-detail overlay slots. The center should feel open and navigable; leave the top 18% low contrast for heading and HUD. Do not draw isolated panels, markers, arrows or a legend. No thick outer border.
Lighting/mood: sunny gentle campus day, inviting miniature board-game world, visible warm textured paper, rich but restrained autumn colors. Avoid large white empty regions, glossy 3D, neon, photographic foliage or bland flat diagram styles.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, watermarks, logos, UI elements, pictograms, card frames, grid or montage. All edges intact. This is an environment map background that will be covered by interactive Godot controls.
